integrity: Defining scheme ideal derived from all basis pairs. Radical follows from explicit square equations and geometric primality. Smoothness and singularities use the Jacobian criterion. Point counts and motivic class use an algebraic determinant-fiber stratification. Nonreducedness has an explicit obstructed first-order deformation, not inferred from finite experiments.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the three-dimensional skew-nilpotent associative algebra, with any base field.
Grothendieck-ring and finite-field counts refer to the reduction and cannot detect nilpotents.
Field-valued operator classification is in the 2021 source and is not proposed as new.
Possible equivalent scheme-theoretic treatment under another algebra label remains a literature risk.
title: A nonreduced Rota–Baxter scheme with a smooth generic reduction
